We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings. We evaluate 11 open-source models across four decoding configurations on all 1,000 problems of EffiBench, a state-of-the-art performance benchmark, while collecting per-process, hardware-level energy measurements throughout. Inference energy spans 0.79 to 8.68 MJ across model-variant pairs, which is roughly equivalent to the energy of 250 to 2800 GPT-4.1 queries. Limiting the maximum number of output tokens has the largest impact, reducing energy use by up to 69% compared to the default configuration. On the execution side, 42 of 44 configurations produce code that consumes more energy per problem than the canonical human reference, with overheads ranging from +4% to +886%. The two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points on the order of 10^6 to 10^7 executions. Mixture-of-Experts architectures consume substantially less inference energy than equivalently-sized dense models without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not always aligned goals: LLM self-refinement consistently produces faster-seeking but energy-heavier code relative to what a human engineer would write. All artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598170.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027)
arxiv.titleZh: 绿色代码还是昂贵代码？评估基于LLM的迭代式代码优化的能源成本
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM代码优化中“执行更快即更省能”的默认假设，在EffiBench全部1000道题上，用11个开源模型、4种解码配置做硬件级能耗测量，覆盖自改进优化流程与最终代码执行两侧。推理能耗跨模型组合达0.79–8.68 MJ（约相当于250–2800次GPT-4.1查询），限制输出token上限最多可降69%能耗；44个配置中有42个生成的代码每题能耗高于人类参考解，超出+4%至+886%，仅两例有微弱收益且回本需10^6–10^7次执行。MoE架构推理能耗显著低于同等规模稠密模型，说明架构选择比解码参数更是可持续性的关键杠杆；执行更快与更省能并不一致，为LLM代码优化的能耗评估与模型选型提供实证依据。
arxiv.reason: LLM代码优化的能耗评测，属代码智能与效率交叉的实证工作

arxiv.title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
arxiv.abstract: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separation through a purely geometric approach: changing the embedding domain from the unit sphere, $S^{d-1}$, to the probability simplex, $Δ^{d-1}$. Although both manifolds share the same intrinsic dimension, the simplex acts as a structural prior; its nonnegative, unit-mass constraints serve as a cross-modal calibration that forces both modalities to ground themselves in the same coordinate system. By attaching lightweight softmax adapters and using Total Variation similarity, we reduce the centroid $\ell_2$ gap by 97--99\% across five multimodal retrieval benchmarks. This confirms that simplicial geometry induces genuine semantic alignment, matching or exceeding the retrieval performance of standard unconstrained models.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过单纯形约束表示闭合模态间隔
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态对比模型（如 CLIP、CLAP）的嵌入长期存在持久的模态间隔。该工作不依赖额外训练目标，而是把嵌入空间从单位球面 S^{d-1} 换到概率单纯形 Δ^{d-1}，借助非负、单位质量的约束作为跨模态校准，使两个模态共享同一坐标系，并配合轻量 softmax 适配器与全变差（Total Variation）相似度。在五个多模态检索基准上，质心 ℓ2 间隔下降 97–99%，检索性能与无约束模型持平或更优，说明单纯形几何本身就能诱导语义对齐。该结论对多模态表示空间的几何设计与检索系统调优有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: 多模态对比表示几何改进，属 MLLM 理解侧扎实工作

arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
arxiv.abstract: Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to logarithmic factors in the stated regimes. The results show that predictions can reduce transition learning to uncovered rows and that learning a near-optimal policy can require fewer prediction samples than estimating the Bayesian value function.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于多步转移预测的强化学习：一种贝尔曼理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究多步转移预测在折扣有限MDP中的价值难以量化、直接纳入状态会导致状态空间指数增长的问题。采用块反馈协议：每个K周期块开始时观测部分动作的K步概率转移预测，并在块内根据状态调整决策；证明最优值满足原状态空间上的贝叶斯贝尔曼方程，并用Bellman–Jensen分析刻画预测视野、误差、动作覆盖与块内反馈的影响。提出BF–BOLA基于模型的离线学习算法，给出上下样本复杂度界（对数因子内匹配），并表明预测可将转移学习限制到未覆盖行，且学习近最优策略所需的预测样本可能少于估计贝叶斯值函数。
arxiv.reason: 通用RL理论，未涉及LLM后训练或Agent，仅方向擦边

arxiv.title: NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time. Existing speculative-decoding methods are poorly suited to this setting: model-based drafters consume scarce GPU memory and may become misaligned as the policy evolves, while existing model-free methods do not explicitly exploit repetition across training epochs. We observe that recent rollouts of the same prompt provide a high-quality, self-updating draft source. Based on this insight, we propose NgramRL, a per-prompt n-gram drafter constructed from bounded recent rollout history. NgramRL requires no auxiliary model, drafter training, or persistent GPU-resident drafter state, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. To hide CPU cache lookup and scheduling, we further introduce an adaptive fan-out prefetcher that predicts likely verification outcomes (j, b), consisting of the accepted draft length j and target-emitted continuation token b. A causal budget allocator concentrates prefetches on high-probability outcomes, while uncovered outcomes fall back to sequential lookup without changing committed tokens. Across two model families and three reasoning and structured-generation workloads, NgramRL commits 3.60-7.77 tokens per target-model forward in the warm-cache regime, up to 1.99x more than SuffixDecoding and 7.0x more than prompt-lookup decoding. On Spider, the prefetcher covers 96.6% of Qwen3-8B outcomes at a candidate budget of 16 and improves measured rollout throughput by 1.38x over synchronous NgramRL, approaching its 1.40x overlap ceiling.
arxiv.titleZh: NgramRL:通过面向 Rollout 的 N-gram 推测解码加速结构化生成的 RL 后训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 RL 后训练中自回归 rollout 占训练时间七成以上的开销问题，提出按 prompt 构建的 n-gram 草稿器:以有界近期 rollout 历史作为自更新草稿源，无需辅助模型、草稿训练或常驻 GPU 的草稿状态，并由目标模型验证以保持 rollout 分布不变;同时引入自适应 fan-out 预取器预测验证结果(j,b)，其中 j 为接受的草稿长度，b 为目标模型续写的 token，由因果预算分配器把预取集中在高概率结果上，未覆盖的结果则回退到顺序查找。在两个模型族、三类推理与结构化生成任务上，热缓存下每次目标模型前向提交 3.60–7.77 个 token，较 SuffixDecoding 最高提升 1.99x、较 prompt-lookup decoding 提升 7.0x;在 Spider 上预算为 16 时覆盖 Qwen3-8B 的 96.6% 结果，rollout 吞吐较同步版 NgramRL 提升 1.38x，接近 1.40x 的重叠上限。
arxiv.reason: RL rollout 加速与推测解码结合，切中系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
arxiv.abstract: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) global rank allocation, where uncalibrated error proxies fail to capture complex error propagation, and (ii) decomposition quality, where Fisher-based estimators suffer from severe rank collapse. In this work, we address these limitations by introducing Layer-wise Error Modeling Search (LEMS) and KFAC-SVD. LEMS advances rank allocation by introducing a layer-wise error surrogate that integrates local and global layer importance alongside a propagation bias, enabling effective global rank allocation via an ILP formulation. KFAC-SVD improves decomposition quality by utilizing token-wise statistics, mitigating the rank deficiency observed in prior Fisher-based SVD approaches. Across Mistral, Qwen3, and Llama 3 model families, we show that LEMS consistently outperforms existing search strategies, delivering significant zero-shot accuracy gains of up to 4.8 p.p. that generalize to model sizes of 70B parameters, while KFAC-SVD achieves an average perplexity improvement of 15%. Project page and code: https://lems-svd.github.io
arxiv.titleZh: 通过逐层误差模型搜索推进基于 SVD 的 LLM 压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有低秩 SVD 压缩的两处缺陷——全局秩分配中未校准的误差代理无法刻画复杂误差传播、Fisher 估计分解导致严重秩塌缩——提出 LEMS 与 KFAC-SVD。LEMS 用融合局部与全局层重要性及传播偏置的逐层误差代理，经 ILP 完成全局秩分配；KFAC-SVD 借助 token 级统计缓解秩亏。在 Mistral、Qwen3、Llama 3 上，零样本准确率最高提升 4.8 个百分点并可外推至 70B 规模，困惑度平均改善 15%。
arxiv.reason: LLM 低秩压缩的扎实系统工作，属高效推理方向

arxiv.title: Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
arxiv.abstract: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser's output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C/C++ that produces proof obligations and audited vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul under six evidence conditions that differ only in the notes, including fabricated assurances that a missing check exists and fabricated alarms that an added check is missing. The study covers 916 pairs in four disjoint sets, eleven model configurations from four vendors and 16,572 audits; no model is trained or fine-tuned. True evidence barely improved accuracy (+0.02). False evidence acted asymmetrically: relative to true notes about the same operations, false assurances lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 points, whereas false alarms never significantly lowered accuracy and were disputed far more often. An internally registered replication on seven new models confirmed that false assurances move verdicts towards their claim more than false alarms do (mean asymmetry +0.16, 95% CI +0.10 to +0.24). Instructions in the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference; the best one failed to replicate. Verifying each claim in a separate call and showing the refuted claims raised accuracy under false assurances by 12 points in a pre-specified test (p=0.002) without loss under true evidence; for a second model the gain was smaller and not significant. Pipelines should therefore verify a tool's guarantees before the model relies on them, and studies should measure deference in a direction-aware way.
arxiv.comment: 33 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code: https://github.com/lzh0082-cloud/CODE-DETECTION
arxiv.titleZh: 信任工具:LLM 漏洞审计器对静态分析证据的非对称顺从
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 与静态分析结合的漏洞审计管线中，模型能否分辨真假证据、审查强度是否随证据主张变化，此前未被测量。作者用 C/C++ 过程内分析器生成证明义务，在仅注释不同的六种证据条件下审计 PrimeVul 的漏洞与已修复函数，覆盖 916 对样本、11 种模型配置、共 16572 次审计。真实证据几乎无增益(+0.02);虚假保证使真实漏洞检出率最多下降 19 个百分点，虚假警报则无显著影响且更常被质疑，复现实验显示平均非对称 +0.16(95% CI +0.10 至 +0.24);提示词指令无法可靠抑制这种顺从。将每条声明拆到独立调用中验证并展示被驳倒的声明，可在虚假保证下提升准确率 12 点(p=0.002)。

arxiv.title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
arxiv.abstract: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs
arxiv.titleZh: “真”与“假”相加等于一吗？LLM-Agent 观点模拟中的补全一致性
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究 LLM-Agent 观点模拟中概率报告是否满足补全一致性：将命题改写为其否命题、把每个概率 p 换成 1−p 后，两份报告应相加为 1。在 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 和 Gemma-3-4B 上测试 2304 个网络模拟智能体状态、48 条 AVeriTeC 真实事实核查命题及 24 个双结果受控世界，配对报告之和平均达 1.18，偏离幅度是同义改写的 2 至 10 倍，且在重复采样、不同群体规模与报告强度下持续存在。从互补初态出发的两个群体五轮后即不再互为镜像；将答案与其配对答案的补全取平均可按构造恢复一致性并降低 Brier 损失，但末轮仅在一个模型上优于原始两种措辞中较好者。说明把模拟概率读作信念之前，改写一致性需要单独检验。
arxiv.reason: LLM-Agent 观点模拟的一致性评测，属 Agent 与评估可靠性方向

arxiv.title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.
arxiv.titleZh: J-Comm：LLM Agent 之间由 Jacobian 引导的隐空间通信
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨模型 Agent 的隐空间通信既要保证连续推理质量，又要提供外部模型可读取的接口。J-Comm 包含两部分：免训练的 GEAR 按嵌入空间几何一致性对候选 token 重加权，从而单调提升共识；H+J 接口把 Sender 的反馈分布（H）与词表索引的 Jacobian-lens 中间态线索（J）传给 Receiver，后者用自身词表重建这些线索，并在 prefill 阶段注入中间层，因此无需共享 KV cache，也不要求模型宽度一致。在 Qwen3-8B→Qwen3-4B 的跨模型通信中，七个基准的平均分最高：MATH500 94.80%、GPQA-Diamond 54.55%、AIME2024+2025 73.33%、ALFWorld 62.93%；相比 TextMAS，性能提升 1.29–8.59 个百分点，生成 token 减少 19.2–74.8%。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体隐空间通信，机制新颖且跨模型实验扎实

arxiv.title: From Deliberately Constructed Systemic Representations of the World of Activity to Dialogue: A Five-Level Communication Architecture for Strong Language-Based ASI
arxiv.abstract: This paper proposes a five-level organization of message formation and understanding within thinking and activity in which ASI participates. Its central thesis is that a language model's context is fundamentally incapable of presenting the foundations of utterance formation for examination and verification. These foundations are established in advance by acquired schemas, systemic representations of the world of activity, and connections accepted as true within them. Neither context nor trained LLM weights, in themselves, attest to the presence of deliberately constructed systemic representations. The five levels distinguish systemic representations of the world of activity, a particular situation cut out from those representations, its narrative description, the full sense of a message, and text. A situation's schema-model is not identical to a story about it. A recipient reconstructs the full sense from an abbreviated text through jointly constructed and agreed-upon representations and joint activity. Reverse work proceeds from the full sense through an extended description and the situation's schema-model to the reconstruction of systemic foundations. The theoretical foundations draw on the systems methodology of G. P. Shchedrovitskiy, the structural differential of A. Korzybski, and the Meaning-Text theory of I. A. Mel'chuk. The contribution is a specific systemic-activity organization of content for examining and adjusting message foundations and controlling the consequences of their transformation. Further research concerns large graphical models of activity on reconstructible systemic foundations, distinct from text generation from context.
arxiv.titleZh: 从刻意构建的活动世界系统性表征到对话：面向强语言型ASI的五级通信架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对语言模型的上下文无法呈现话语生成依据这一问题，提出五级通信架构：把活动世界的系统性表征、从中切出的具体情境、情境的叙事描述、讯息的完整含义与文本逐层区分，并指出情境的图式模型不等于关于它的故事；接收方须借助共同建构且达成一致的表征与共同活动，从简略文本重建完整含义，并逆向追溯系统根基。理论来源为Shchedrovitskiy的系统方法论、Korzybski的结构微分与Mel'chuk的意义—文本理论。全文36页，属纯理论建构，无实验验证，后续设想是在可重建系统根基上构建活动大图模型。
arxiv.reason: 纯理论通信层级框架，缺乏实验，与LLM工程方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
arxiv.abstract: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于 TopKLoRA 的可解释稀疏微调实现忠实的电路发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 微调可植入难以定位和移除的后门，而现有参数高效微调虽能记录全部参数变化却不具可解释性。TopKLoRA 在每个 token 上只激活 k 个最大的 adapter latent，仅用下游损失训练，优化压力促使 latent 学成功能上因果的单元。在 sleeper-agent 后门案例中，于 gemma-2-2b、Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上构造含毒指令微调的 model organism，定位到必要且充分的电路，其规模比 dense LoRA 基线小至多一个数量级，消融后不损指令跟随性能；并用 latent 与 gradient-routing 构造局部化电路的 model organism 来验证电路搜索结果。这为可解释设计（interpretable-by-design）的微调架构提供忠实可用的分析单元。
arxiv.reason: 稀疏 LoRA 结合电路发现，方法新颖、实验系统

arxiv.title: PoKER: A Probability of Kill Estimation Rate Model for Air-to-Air Missiles Using Machine Learning on Stochastic Targets
arxiv.abstract: This work introduces PoKER, a novel probabilistic model engineered to optimize missile launch effectiveness in air-to-air scenarios, specifically within Beyond Visual Range (BVR) air combat. Unlike conventional Weapon Engagement Zone (WEZ) models that delineate zones based on static distances such as maximum, minimum, and no-escape ranges, PoKER applies machine learning to predict kill probabilities more accurately by integrating the stochastic behaviors of targets and missile miss distances. This model dynamically evaluates target behavior, greatly expanding the predictive capabilities of engagement analysis. By factoring in elements such as warhead lethality, target and shooter orientations, and the specific conditions of engagement, PoKER provides important insights into engagement dynamics and quantifies success probabilities. Consequently, it can potentially be an important tool for BVR air combat pilots, improving operational decision-making within this specialized combat domain.
arxiv.comment: Accepted manuscript. 18 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code available at https://github.com/jpadantas/poker
arxiv.titleZh: PoKER：基于机器学习与随机目标建模的空空导弹杀伤概率估计模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对超视距空战中传统武器交战区(WEZ)模型仅按最大、最小、不可逃逸距离等静态距离划分区域，无法刻画目标机动随机性的问题，构建 PoKER 概率模型:用机器学习融合目标随机行为与导弹脱靶距离，并纳入战斗部杀伤力、目标与射手姿态、具体交战条件等要素来预测杀伤概率。模型能动态评估目标行为，扩展交战分析的预测范围，为超视距空战飞行员的作战决策提供概率量化依据。

arxiv.title: A Foundation Model for Policy In-Context Longitudinal Causal Effect Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Longitudinal causal effect estimation is complicated by time-varying confounding and treatment-confounder feedback loops. Existing methods generally require data-specific nuisance-model fitting, and many are tailored to prespecified treatment sequences or prediction horizons, leading to time-consuming computation at deployment. We introduce *Policy In-Context Longitudinal causal Effect estimation with Prior-data Fitted Networks* (**PICLE-PFN**), the first foundation model for longitudinal causal effect estimation that supports *dynamic* treatment policies. PICLE-PFN represents target policies through in-context history-decision demonstrations, providing a unified interface for a broad class of treatment policies. Pretrained over synthetic data sampled from longitudinal structural causal models, PICLE-PFN amortizes causal effect estimation across datasets, policies, and horizons. Given a new observational dataset and target policy, it directly predicts conditional average potential outcomes (CAPOs) in one forward pass without task-specific training or hyperparameter tuning. Across synthetic and semi-synthetic longitudinal benchmarks, PICLE-PFN achieves competitive RMSE and substantially improved uncertainty calibration with a fraction of deployment runtime, compared to state-of-the-art conventional estimators trained and tuned separately for each dataset.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向策略的上下文纵向因果效应估计基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 纵向因果效应估计受时变混杂与治疗-混杂反馈影响，现有方法需按数据集拟合 nuisance 模型，且多绑定预设治疗序列或预测时域，部署开销大。PICLE-PFN 用上下文中的历史-决策示范表示目标策略，统一刻画动态治疗策略，并在纵向结构因果模型生成的合成数据上预训练，把跨数据集、跨策略、跨时域的估计摊销到一次前向中，直接输出条件平均潜在结果(CAPO)，无需任务特定训练或调参。在合成与半合成纵向基准上，RMSE 与最先进估计器相当，不确定性校准明显更优，部署耗时仅为后者的一小部分。
arxiv.reason: 基础模型+上下文学习用于因果效应估计，方法与 LLM 范式沾边但非核心方向

arxiv.title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
arxiv.abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities, but their high pretraining cost raises a practical sustainability question: does this upfront investment pay off over a full deployment lifecycle, compared to supervised standalone models that must be periodically retrained? We model the cumulative carbon cost of different approaches across a realistic industrial scenario: Chronos-2 amortizes its pretraining cost within months for large or frequently queried deployments, but a classical model remains cheaper indefinitely for small or rarely queried ones. For cases where reducing the TSFM's own cost matters, we show that removing a single encoder block (7.9% of parameters) via a gradient-free pruning criterion yields a consistent 6 to 9% reduction in FLOPs, CO2 emissions, and latency, at essentially no cost to zero-shot forecasting performance across a 25-task benchmark.
arxiv.comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TS-LIMITS
arxiv.titleZh: TSFM部署与预训练的可持续性：从碳足迹分析到通过剪枝进行减排
arxiv.summaryZh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）零样本预测能力强，但预训练开销高，其全生命周期碳成本是否优于需定期重训的监督式独立模型尚不清楚。该工作以Chronos-2为对象建模工业场景下的累计碳排放：大规模或高频查询部署数月内即可摊薄预训练成本，小规模低频场景下经典模型始终更省。为进一步降低TSFM自身开销，作者采用无梯度剪枝准则移除单个编码器块（占参数7.9%），在25项任务基准上零样本性能基本不变，FLOPs、CO₂排放与延迟均稳定下降6%至9%。

arxiv.title: Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
arxiv.abstract: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real. Yet, weakly regularised algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) remain the de facto choice in sim-to-real pipelines, while the practical benefits of regularisation for transfer remain poorly characterised. In this work, we study the sim-to-real performance of commonly used RL algorithms, with the aim of characterising the effects of regularisation on robotic performance. To that end, we derive Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic (SMM-AC), a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which carries strong robustness guarantees. On MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks, SMM-AC is competitive with baselines like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). On real robots, SMM-AC achieves higher return, while exhibiting greater robustness to perturbations in observations, the environment, and dynamics than baselines. Together, these results demonstrate that regularised RL improves real-world policy deployment through better robustness to the sim-to-real gap, and changing real-world conditions.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages of main-body content, with supporting details in the appendices. Under submission
arxiv.titleZh: 正则化 RL 提升 sim-to-real 迁移
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对正则化 RL 虽有可证明的鲁棒性保证、却在 sim-to-real 流程中不如弱正则的 PPO 常用这一落差，系统考察常用 RL 算法的真机迁移表现。基于 soft mellowmax 价值函数推导出 Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic(SMM-AC)，在保留强鲁棒性保证的同时具备可用的优化性质。在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，其结果与 SAC 等基线相当;在真实机器人上则取得更高回报，且对观测、环境与动力学的扰动更鲁棒。结果表明正则化带来的鲁棒性可缓解 sim-to-real 差距，支撑真机部署。

arxiv.title: Near-Optimal List Replicability from Littlestone Dimension
arxiv.abstract: We study the list replicability number in the realizable PAC learning framework and prove that every concept class $H$ over a countable domain with Littlestone dimension $d$ and dual VC dimension $v^*$ satisfies \[ \mathrm{LR}(H)\leq 2^{O(d\min\{\log d,v^*\})}. \] This matches the worst-case lower bound of $2^{Ω(d)}$ up to a logarithmic factor in the exponent and exponentially improves the previous best upper bound $\mathrm{LR}(H)\le 2^{2^{O(d)}}$ of Bun, Livni, and Moran [FOCS 2020]. Unlike earlier bounds of $2^{O_ε(d^2)}$ for fixed accuracy $ε>0$ implied by the work of Ghazi, Golowich, Kumar, and Manurangsi [STOC 2021] and Lyu [STOC 2026], our bound is independent of $ε$. The $2^{O(d\log d)}$ bound follows from a new inductive framework for bounding list replicability that builds on the recent notion of irreducibility from differentially private learning. The $2^{O(dv^*)}$ bound follows from a simple globally stable learner that takes the majority vote of multiple empirical risk minimizers, with stability established using tools from stable regularity.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于 Littlestone 维度的近乎最优列表可复现性
arxiv.summaryZh: 在可实现 PAC 学习框架下研究列表可复现数，证明可数域上 Littlestone 维度为 d、对偶 VC 维为 v* 的概念类满足 LR(H)≤2^{O(d·min{log d, v*})}，把此前 2^{2^{O(d)}} 的上界在指数上降到接近 2^{Ω(d)} 的最坏情形下界，且不依赖精度 ε。关键技术是借助差分隐私学习中「不可约性」概念构造的归纳框架，以及取多个经验风险最小化器多数投票的全局稳定学习器(用稳定正则性工具证明稳定性)。结果属于学习理论中可复现性与差分隐私学习交叉的基础进展。

arxiv.title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
arxiv.abstract: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation. A seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline recovered this logic, processing 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery does not confer usability. Entities like offer, eligibility, and activation recur across services under a shared vocabulary, related in name but operationally distinct, so one end-to-end journey implicates over a thousand near-identical rules that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails, returning an identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity with no signal of error. Content-level ontology, the traditional remedy, did not exist, and relating every occurrence of recurring entities would have cost more than the engagement and not survived a release cycle. We place the ontology at the artifact level. In this machine-generated corpus, each artifact retains its producer, component, service, domain and type, provenance that disambiguates before content is read. We present a knowledge layer that organizes before retrieving: a self-describing catalog, a sparse metadata registry, and a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities. Queries resolve to artifact identifiers that constrain vector search, so the competing rule from another service is absent rather than outranked, making disambiguation structural, not statistical. Built in under a week and admitting new services by convention, the layer serves SDLC agents, developers, quality engineers and analysts. It supported root-cause analysis and resolution of 100+ production defects with developer verification and attributed 35 release regression failures to specific rules and services.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新构想面向多智能体系统的企业级RAG：先组织后检索的知识层
arxiv.summaryZh: 企业智能体需要系统行为逻辑而非干系人文档：七智能体逆向工程流水线把241个仓库、18个服务转成数千个描述范围、旅程、规则与验收标准的工件。由于offer、eligibility等实体跨服务共享词汇却操作含义不同，扁平向量检索会把错误服务的近似规则以高相似度召回且不报错。该工作把本体下沉到工件层，用自描述目录、稀疏元数据注册表和基于工件的导航超图先做结构化消歧，再以工件ID约束向量检索。该层不到一周建成，支持100多个生产缺陷的根因分析与修复，并将35个发布回归失败归因到具体规则和服务。

arxiv.title: Neural LoFi with Backward Coupling: A Spectral Theory of Cross-Layer Feature Learning
arxiv.abstract: During joint training, backpropagation allows later layers to reshape earlier representations, a feedback mechanism absent from purely layer-wise learning. We extend Neural Low-Degree Filtering (Neural LoFi), a recently proposed layer-wise spectral surrogate for feature learning, to capture this interaction. Starting from the exact backpropagation gradients, we derive a local coupling between a neuron's incoming weights and its corresponding next-layer column. In a controlled small-initialization regime with smooth activations and fixed surroundings, these dynamics amplify singular modes of a cross-layer correlation operator. Each growing mode pairs an earlier feature with an upper-layer response through shared neuron coefficients. This motivates a backward-coupling algorithm in which upper-layer sensitivities generate sample-dependent effective labels for earlier spectral steps, while corrected features refine upward transmission. A function-space variational principle characterizes the selected feature-response pairs by maximizing the label correlation of their product under kernel-norm constraints. For three-layer networks, we derive self-consistent continuous-time dynamics for the filtered hidden-layer features, the activation kernels, and the network output under the proposed backward coupling. In a hierarchical multi-index model, we establish a feature-recovery separation: backward coupling recovers lower-layer directions invisible to the original forward label-weighted statistic. The linear specialization recovers residual-dependent singular-mode dynamics, while paired modes provide a dynamical mechanism for linked low-rank covariance components consistent with the rainbow-network picture. Experiments with fully connected and convolutional networks on binary CIFAR-10 show improved accuracy over forward Neural LoFi at matched widths.
arxiv.titleZh: 带反向耦合的 Neural LoFi：跨层特征学习的谱理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 逐层学习缺少反向传播带来的跨层反馈。该工作将 Neural LoFi 这一逐层谱替代模型扩展为反向耦合版本，从精确梯度导出神经元输入权重与下一层列的局部耦合，并在小初始化、平滑激活的受控条件下刻画跨层相关算子的奇异模态放大。由此提出反向耦合算法：上层敏感度生成样本相关的有效标签供前层谱步骤使用，修正后的特征再向上传递；函数空间变分原理刻画所选特征—响应对。三层网络连续动力学与分层多指标模型分析显示，反向耦合可恢复前向标签加权统计看不到的低层方向；二分类 CIFAR-10 上全连接与卷积网络在相同宽度下优于前向 Neural LoFi。

arxiv.title: Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings
arxiv.abstract: It is essential that we communicate with the entirety of an affected population during a crisis, including those who do not speak a region's dominant language(s). Commercial Translation tools offer a tempting solution to broaden access and can provide a lifeline when no other resources are available. However, Emergency response managers often operate in the dark regarding the quality and adequacy of these automated outputs. In this paper, we conduct a nationwide survey of emergency managers to understand their current workflows, perspectives, and operational challenges. We then evaluate commercial translation tools against these needs, shedding light on their utility and offering practical guidance on how and when these tools can be safely used in emergency response.

arxiv.titleZh: 与全体民众沟通：应急警报与警示的机器翻译
arxiv.summaryZh: 危机发生时，如何把应急警报传达给不讲当地主导语言的人群是长期被忽视的问题，商业翻译工具虽被应急管理者使用，但其输出质量与适用性缺乏可靠依据。工作先对美国应急管理者做全国性问卷调查，梳理其现有工作流程、观点与操作难点，再以这些需求为基准评测商业翻译工具的实际表现。结果给出这些工具在应急响应中可用与不可用的边界，并附上何时、如何安全使用的实践建议。适用于公共安全、危机沟通与低资源语言场景下的机器翻译落地。

arxiv.title: On the Limits of Sparse Linear Model with Shuffled Differential Privacy
arxiv.abstract: Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differential privacy. Shuffled differential privacy (SDP) sits between the two, offering accuracy closer to the central model without the trust requirement of a central curator. This paper studies sparse linear regression under both non-interactive and interactive SDP protocols. In the non-interactive setting, any non-interactive $(ε,δ)$-SDP protocol is shown to incur an $\ell_2$-norm estimation error of $Ω( \frac{\sqrt{dk}}{nε} )$ with dimension $d$, sparsity $k$, and $n$ users, revealing an inherent dimensionality barrier. In addition, a non-interactive algorithm is proposed that achieves an $\ell_2$-norm upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( \sqrt{\frac{k}{n}} + \frac{d\sqrt{k}}{nε})$. To overcome this barrier, we turn to the interactive user-level setting, where each user holds $m$ samples. A two-round interactive algorithm is developed that first recovers the support through a heavy hitter step and then estimates the parameter, achieving an error of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( \sqrt{\frac{k}{nm}} + \frac{k}{n\sqrt{m}ε} )$ with no polynomial dependence on $d$. Furthermore, by extending the score attack framework to user-level data, a new lower bound $Ω( \sqrt{\frac{k\log(d/k)}{nm}} + \frac{k\log(d/k)}{n\sqrt{m}ε} )$ is established for any user-level $(ε,δ)$-DP, showing that the proposed algorithm is near-optimal with only a gap of the factor $\log(d/k)$.
arxiv.titleZh: 论混洗差分隐私下稀疏线性模型的局限
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究混洗差分隐私（SDP）下稀疏线性回归的估计误差极限：在非交互协议中证明任意（ε，δ）-SDP 协议的 ℓ2 误差下界为 Ω（√（dk）/（nε）），揭示维度壁垒，并给出误差上界 Õ（√（k/n）+d√k/（nε））的非交互算法。为突破该壁垒，转向每用户持 m 条样本的交互式用户级设置，设计两轮算法：先用 heavy hitter 步骤恢复支撑集，再估计参数，误差达 Õ（√（k/（nm））+k/（n√mε）），对维度 d 无多项式依赖。将 score attack 框架扩展到用户级数据，得到 Ω（√（k log（d/k）/（nm））+k log（d/k）/（n√mε））的下界，说明所提算法在 log（d/k）因子内近最优。

arxiv.title: KrishokTech: A Bengali Agricultural Advisory System with Explicit Authorization Controls
arxiv.abstract: For agricultural advisory, generating an answer is only part of the problem: the system must also control unsafe requests, work with limited connectivity, and accommodate changing guidance. KRISHOKTECH is a Bengali agricultural advisory system built around an explicit authorization boundary around generation. Before retrieval, normalization and rule-based admission checks refer policy-covered high-risk requests and ask for a crop when treatment intent is underspecified. The system then binds retrieval to a single crop and asks for confirmation when the text and image indicate different crops. After generation, a narrow verifier removes dosage claims not supported by retrieved BARI/BRRI evidence. Agricultural guidance is kept in an external evidence index that can be updated without retraining the generator, while browser-side vision and local retrieval reduce connectivity requirements. The interface makes these decisions visible as ASK, CONFIRM, REFER, and DROP, together with their evidence. On 200 farmer queries and 400 stress queries, the controls halted underspecified requests and reduced cross-crop retrieval violations from 36.5% to 0% under the tested alias filter. Mismatch detection caught 453 of 454 text-image conflicts, while the verifier caught 114 of 118 inserted dosage errors. The demonstration shows how these controls govern the path from request to delivered advice.
arxiv.titleZh: KrishokTech:一个带显式授权控制的孟加拉语农业咨询系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向孟加拉语农业咨询的检索增强系统，在生成前后各设授权边界:检索前做归一化与规则准入，对政策覆盖的高风险请求转交处理、治疗意图不明确时追问作物;检索阶段绑定单一作物，图文作物不一致时要求确认;生成后用窄域校验器删除缺乏BARI/BRRI证据支持的剂量声明。农业指导存于可外部更新的证据索引，无需重训生成器，浏览器端视觉与本地检索降低联网依赖，界面以ASK、CONFIRM、REFER、DROP呈现各项决策及依据。在200条农户查询与400条压力查询上，跨作物检索违规从36.5%降至0%，图文冲突检出453/454，插入的剂量错误检出114/118。

arxiv.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
arxiv.abstract: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.
arxiv.titleZh: HarnessMM：面向 harness token 效率的递归自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Agent harness 在工具反馈后反复触发推理调用、即便先前调用已确定下一步动作的冗余问题，提出 HarnessMM：在模型—工具边界设置控制器，用可执行决策图记录确切动作、字面参数、因果依赖与公开守卫，通过守卫式决策复用替换后续推理回调，并以带验证筛选的递归自我改进迭代调整 harness 配置，Actor 权重保持冻结。HumanEval 上 Codex 成功率维持 90.82%，Tokens/task 从 66.72k 降至 47.02k（节省 29.54%）；DeepSeek Harness 上成功率由 71.43% 升至 85.71%，Tokens/task 从 96.28k 降至 11.62k（节省 87.93%）；MBPP 消融显示成本较单次使用图低 26.91%、较保留回调低 19.52%。该工作把重复推理消除落到现有 harness 的工程改造上，适用于工具调用型 Agent 的推理成本优化。

arxiv.title: U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
arxiv.abstract: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context. A shared architecture and training framework were developed using low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure datasets containing 51, 98, and 278 neonates, respectively, comprising over 11,000 hours of EEG and 82,000 annotated events. Performance was compared with task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers. For seizure detection, we also evaluated U-NeXt+, trained on an expanded dataset. Both U-NeXt variants and the ConvNeXt baseline were evaluated on two independent held-out seizure datasets, Helsinki and Cork, comprising 130 neonates, with recordings annotated by three experts. U-NeXt improved detection across all three event types, with particular gains in sensitivity for short events. U-NeXt+ achieved Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.862 and 0.891 on Helsinki and Cork, respectively, and improved hourly seizure burden correlations by 30-40% relative to ConvNeXt. U-NeXt+ met the criterion for expert-level performance on both datasets (p < 0.001). In separate computational benchmarks, U-NeXt reduced batch inference time relative to ConvNeXt by 254-fold on a central processing unit and 200-fold on a graphics processing unit. A common segmentation framework improves detection across diverse neonatal EEG event types while substantially reducing inference time. Accurate seizure burden estimates and performance comparable to expert reviewers support its potential use in continuous monitoring and clinical decision support.
arxiv.titleZh: U-NeXt:面向新生儿EEG的通用事件检测框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对新生儿脑电图(EEG)中低电压段、伪迹与癫痫发作等多类事件的检测，构建基于语义分割的通用框架U-NeXt:卷积编码器-解码器直接对单通道长片段做分割以保留时间上下文，并以统一架构在51/98/278名新生儿、逾11000小时EEG与82000个标注事件上训练。在Helsinki与Cork两个独立留出集(130名新生儿、三位专家标注)上，U-NeXt+的MCC达0.862与0.891，每小时发作负荷相关性较ConvNeXt提升30–40%，达到专家级判读标准(p<0.001)，推理速度在CPU与GPU上分别快254倍与200倍。结果支持其在新生儿连续脑电监护与临床辅助决策中的潜在应用。

arxiv.title: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.
arxiv.titleZh: Frontier-OPD：发现 Agent 能力的边界，并教 Agent 超越边界
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向多轮 Agent 的 on-policy 蒸馏，需要同时判断两件事：哪里需要教师指导，以及学生能否在得到提示后维持交互。Frontier-OPD 由此把 on-policy 经验组织成共享状态轨迹图，用轨迹平衡的师生分歧来定位干预候选点；又以学生接受短教师桥接后的后续延续段，与原始轨迹等长段之间的一致性作为筛选依据，接受的数据则并入蒸馏数据。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上，各学生规模与教师配置下的平均自主成功率均优于对比蒸馏基线；消融显示候选选择与引导过滤具有互补作用，某 ALFWorld 设置下额外采集成本被更短的达标时间抵消。

arxiv.title: Multiplicative vs. Additive State Coupling in Learned Optimizer Schedules
arxiv.abstract: We learn schedules for a continuous penalty relaxation of MAX-CUT by backpropagating through an unrolled classical solver. A state-blind schedule generalizes to instances substantially larger than those used for training. A state-adaptive bilinear schedule also generalizes out of distribution, outperforming its untrained baseline across 15 seeds ($t=4.1$). By contrast, an additive ablation with identical inputs and output heads is statistically indistinguishable from the bilinear model in distribution but performs worse than its own baseline out of distribution ($t=-11.7$). This separation appears without regularization and persists across a $30$ round weight-decay sweep: the bilinear advantage remains significant at every tested value, whereas the additive model never recovers. The results in this setting isolate how solver state enters the schedule, rather than state adaptivity alone, as the architectural distinction associated with out-of-distribution transfer.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习型优化器调度中乘性与加性状态耦合的对比
arxiv.summaryZh: 通过展开经典求解器并反向传播，为MAX-CUT的连续惩罚松弛学习优化调度:状态无关调度可泛化到远大于训练规模的实例;依赖求解器状态的双线性调度同样能分布外泛化，在15个随机种子上优于未训练基线(t=4.1)。输入与输出头完全一致的可加性消融在分布内与双线性模型无统计差异，但分布外反而劣于自身基线(t=-11.7)。该分离现象无需正则化即出现，并在30轮权重衰减扫描中持续存在，说明决定分布外迁移的是求解器状态以乘性还是加性方式进入调度，而非状态自适应本身。
arxiv.reason: 学习型优化器调度虽沾优化器方向，但场景为MAX-CUT组合优化，与LLM训练关联弱

arxiv.title: CARES: Coverage-Aware Replay Exemplar Selection for Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: Replay-based Continual Learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by keeping a buffer of past samples, making buffer composition critical under a fixed memory budget. Recent coreset-based replay methods improve buffer quality using model-derived gradients, losses, or auxiliary optimization, but incur substantial computational overhead as memory is repeatedly updated. We propose CARES, a continual model-optimization-free approach for buffer construction that instead exploits the geometry of a frozen pretrained feature space using class-aware, density-weighted coverage. We evaluate CARES across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams under online class- and task-incremental settings. On Tiny-ImageNet, CARES is 2.3 to 8.8 times faster than existing coreset-based selectors. Although CARES achieves this speedup using no training signal from the continual learner, it ranks among the state of the art across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams under online class- and task-incremental settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 7.58 percentage points under class imbalance while also attaining higher average accuracy on Tiny-ImageNet. Code will be released upon publication
arxiv.titleZh: CARES：面向持续学习的覆盖感知回放样本选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 回放式持续学习在固定内存预算下高度依赖缓冲区的样本构成，现有基于coreset的方法需借助梯度、损失或辅助优化来筛选样本，缓冲区每更新一次就要付出可观的计算开销。CARES转而利用冻结预训练特征空间的几何结构，以类别感知、密度加权的覆盖度直接构建缓冲区，全程不使用持续学习器的训练信号。在Tiny-ImageNet上，它比现有coreset选择器快2.3至8.8倍；且在均衡、类别不平衡与标签噪声数据流、online class-incremental与task-incremental设定下均达到SOTA水平，类别不平衡时最高领先最强基线7.58个百分点。
arxiv.reason: 视觉持续学习的缓冲区选择，与LLM后训练仅方向擦边

arxiv.title: ParaTaxe: a Suite of Tools for Processing and Publishing Multi-parallel Corpora
arxiv.abstract: Over the past fifteen years, digital tools for parallelizing and aligning textual corpora have developed significantly within the field of digital humanities. Several projects and software tools have been created to compare different translations or versions of texts. Despite these technical advances, many parallel corpora produced in academic contexts quickly become inaccessible online due to the lack of maintenance or funding. To address this gap, we present a suite of open-source tools developed within the ACR Grimm Tradalign and ParaTaxe projects. This suite includes the AIlign aligner, based on multilingual embeddings, a Python processing pipeline for converting and aligning corpora, a web interface called ParaTaxe for managing collections of parallel corpora, and a web interface for exploring aligned corpora built with TEI-Publisher.
arxiv.titleZh: ParaTaxe:一套用于处理与发布多平行语料的工具
arxiv.summaryZh: 数字人文领域已有的平行语料对齐工具虽有不少，但学术项目产出的语料常因缺乏维护与资助而迅速下线、无法访问。为此构建一套开源工具链:AILign 基于多语言嵌入完成对齐，配套 Python 处理流水线负责语料格式转换与对齐，ParaTaxe 网页界面用于管理平行语料集合，另有基于 TEI-Publisher 的界面用于浏览已对齐语料。工具覆盖从对齐、转换到发布、浏览的完整链路，服务于多译本、多版本文本的长期可访问与再利用。
arxiv.reason: 数字人文语料对齐与发布工具，与 LLM 关注方向仅边缘相关

arxiv.title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
arxiv.abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.
arxiv.titleZh: 每条边都需要引文:用语言模型智能体构建医疗软件采购的引文锚定知识图谱
arxiv.summaryZh: 医院采购软件需要同行的使用证据，而这类信息散落在厂商网站、新闻稿与第三方页面中;LLM智能体可低成本采集，但抽取结论的正确性难以验证，错列客户会误导买家并误指机构。工作构建了一条流水线:先确定性爬取各厂商站点，再用有预算的ReAct智能体检索其余网页，由宽松抽取器提出带原文引文的关系，随后分层接地阶段通过指代补全、确定性校验与五次模型调用按九项准则投票来筛选。在61家厂商上达0.94精确率、0.71召回率，基于投票的置信度分数在0.90召回时仍保持0.90精确率。其字符串匹配证据与投票机制对长上下文退化与运行间方差的抑制，适用于需要可溯源证据的抽取与知识图谱构建场景。
arxiv.reason: 智能体抽取加引文接地与投票校验有参考价值，但属垂直应用

arxiv.title: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of HER2 Status from Whole-Brain MRI in Breast Cancer Brain Metastases
arxiv.abstract: Purpose: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status is a key biomarker relevant for prognostication and treatment decision making in metastatic breast cancer. Thus, the aim of this work was to explore whether HER2 status can be predicted directly from whole-brain post-contrast T1-weighted (T1w) MRI scans in breast cancer brain metastases (BCBM) using deep learning, and whether providing explicit tumour segmentation information improves prediction. Methods: Using the publicly available BCBM-Radiogenomics dataset, we analysed 135 patients, including 70 HER2+ and 65 HER2- patients. Three approaches were implemented and evaluated: a conventional radiomics model, a simple fully convolutional network (SFCN) using T1w MRI scans alone, and an SFCN using T1w MRI scans with an expert-derived tumour mask as an additional input channel. Results: The radiomics model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.602 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.528--0.677) while the SFCN achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.667 (95% CI, 0.63--0.71) using T1w MRI scans alone, which increased to 0.692 (95% CI, 0.58--0.81) when an explicit tumour mask was additionally provided. Conclusion: However, the modest performance across all approaches demonstrates the difficulty of predicting HER2 status from structural MRI scans alone. The difference between the segmentation-free and mask-guided SFCN models suggests that much of the predictive signal captured by the deep-learning model may be learned directly from whole-brain T1w MRI without requiring explicit tumour delineation. These findings support further investigation of segmentation-free deep-learning approaches as a potential non-invasive strategy to support HER2 status determination in BCBM.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于深度学习的乳腺癌脑转移全脑MRI HER2状态预测
arxiv.summaryZh: HER2状态是乳腺癌转移预后判断与治疗决策的关键生物标志物，本研究探索能否直接从全脑增强T1加权MRI预测该状态。在公开BCBM-Radiogenomics数据集135例患者（70例HER2+、65例HER2−）上比较三种方案：传统影像组学、仅用T1w的简单全卷积网络（SFCN），以及额外引入专家肿瘤分割掩膜通道的SFCN。结果ROC-AUC分别为0.602、0.667与0.692，说明仅凭结构MRI预测HER2仍然困难，而无分割模型已能捕获大部分预测信号，支持将免分割深度学习作为辅助HER2判定的非侵入策略继续研究。
arxiv.reason: 医疗影像预测生物标志物，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment with Reward-Model Gradients
arxiv.abstract: GRPO shares a response-level advantage across tokens, leaving unresolved how strongly each token should contribute to learning. Updates induced by the shared advantage reinforce or suppress the sampled token at each position, but these updates do not always point toward increasing reward at the token level. This motivates a work-based view of credit: just as work depends on the component of force along a displacement, token credit should reflect the local reward change along the policy update direction. We introduce Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment (DATC), which maps frozen reward-model gradients into policy logit space and allocates weights by evaluating the alignment between the reward direction and GRPO's signed sampled-action update direction, while preserving the sign and mean of the response-level advantage. DATC outperforms GRPO in all four settings across two model families.
arxiv.titleZh: 方向感知的 token 信用分配：利用奖励模型梯度
arxiv.summaryZh: GRPO在整条回复上共享同一个优势值，无法区分每个 token 对学习应贡献多少；共享优势带来的更新有时并不指向提升奖励的方向。DATC 把冻结奖励模型的梯度映射到策略 logit 空间，用奖励梯度方向与 GRPO 带符号采样动作更新方向的对齐程度来分配 token 权重，同时保持回复级优势的符号与均值不变。在两个模型系列共四个设置上均优于 GRPO。该工作为 RLVR 后训练的细粒度信用分配提供了可即插即用的思路。
arxiv.reason: 针对 GRPO token 级信用分配的扎实改进，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.
arxiv.titleZh: On-Policy Self-Training：大语言模型中的无数据自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏依赖真实问答对、人工题目集或其他监督信号，限制了模型的自我改进能力。该工作将 on-policy 自蒸馏重构为自训练框架：仅给定粗粒度的高层主题描述，模型便自行合成问题课程与特权推理演示，再以这些完全合成的信息做 on-policy 自蒸馏。在标准语言基准与视觉问答任务上，该方法在多个领域取得一致的自我提升，同时保留未参与自训练领域的能力，并在文本与多模态场景下验证了通用性。结果表明，基座模型的潜在能力可在无外部任务监督、无人工题目分布的条件下被放大。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 自蒸馏叠加无数据自进化，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.
arxiv.titleZh: ActionRAG：面向 LLM Agent 长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM Agent 长期记忆的两个薄弱环节——索引阶段实体被错误拆分或合并、在线检索把初始相似度当作最终分数——提出图记忆架构 ActionRAG：索引侧统一类型标签并做分层实体消解；查询时用实体与三元组双通道检索构造有界局部图，再以查询条件化、接收端归一化的扩散沿路径结构修正三元组分数，配合种子保护、枢纽惩罚与三元组实体化保留直接证据。在 MemoryAgentBench 八个确定性评分列上平均准确率 55.1，较最强检索式记忆基线高 5.4 分；单查询合成成本低于 0.001 美元，检索侧 p99 分项合计 440.7 ms。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长期记忆加图扩散检索精炼，命中 Agent 记忆方向且系统完整

arxiv.title: On the Identifiability of Hybrid Deep Generative Models: Meta-Learning as a Solution
arxiv.abstract: The interest in leveraging physics-based inductive bias in deep learning has resulted in recent development of hybrid deep generative models (hybrid-DGMs) that integrate known physics-based mathematical expressions in neural generative models. To identify these hybrid-DGMs requires inferring parameters of the physics-based component along with their neural component. The identifiability of these hybrid-DGMs, however, has not yet been theoretically probed or established. How does the existing theory of the un-identifiability of general DGMs apply to hybrid-DGMs? What may be an effective approach to construct a hybrid-DGM with theoretically-proven identifiability? This paper provides the first theoretical probe into the identifiability of hybrid-DGMs, and presents meta-learning as a novel solution to construct identifiable hybrid-DGMs. On synthetic and real-data benchmarks, we provide strong empirical evidence for the un-identifiability of existing hybrid-DGMs using unconditional priors, and strong identifiability results of the presented meta-formulations of hybrid-DGMs. Code is available at https://github.com/GoForIt-YYB/Meta-Hybrid-VAE.
arxiv.titleZh: 论混合深度生成模型的可辨识性：元学习作为解决方案
arxiv.summaryZh: 混合深度生成模型将已知物理表达式嵌入神经生成模型，但物理参数与网络参数能否被唯一辨识尚缺乏理论分析。论文首次从理论上刻画这类模型的可辨识性，指出采用无条件先验的现有方法存在不可辨识性，并提出基于元学习的元表述来构造可辨识的混合生成模型。合成数据与真实数据实验验证了现有模型不可辨识，以及元表述具有强可辨识性。适用于科学建模中需要参数可解释的生成式方法。
arxiv.reason: 物理混合生成模型的可辨识性理论，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: Strongly Adaptive Online Learning with Time-Varying Movement Costs
arxiv.abstract: We study strongly adaptive regret for Online Convex Optimization (OCO) with time-varying movement costs, a setting that evaluates a learner's performance over arbitrary sub-intervals. This framework captures complex sequential decision-making problems where both the environment and the cost of switching decisions fluctuate over time. We propose a novel algorithm which, for any interval $[a,b] \subseteq [T]$, achieves a data-dependent regret bound of $ \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \sqrt{(D^2+DP_{[a,b]})\sum_{t \in [a,b]}(\|g_t\|^2+λ_t\|g_t\|)} \right) $, where $D$ is the diameter of the decision domain, $P_{[a,b]}$ is the path length of the comparator sequence over $[a,b]$, $g_t$ is the gradient of the loss, and $λ_t$ is the movement-cost coefficient at round $t$. Key to our approach is a novel reduction to sleeping experts with movement costs, a previously unexplored variant that is of independent interest. As a result of this development, we further establish the first strongly-adaptive guarantees under delayed feedback. Our approach also naturally extends to OCO with time-varying memory, where we obtain strongly-adaptive guarantees which improve the best-known bounds.
arxiv.titleZh: 带时变移动成本的强自适应在线学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究带时变移动成本的在线凸优化中的强自适应遗憾，即在任意子区间上同时衡量环境波动与切换代价的性能。核心方法是将问题归约为带移动成本的 sleeping experts 这一新变体，并据此给出对任意区间[a,b]成立的数据相关遗憾界 Õ(√((D²+DP_[a,b])Σ_{t∈[a,b]}(‖g_t‖²+λ_t‖g_t‖)))，其中 P 为比较器路径长度、λ_t 为移动成本系数。该归约还首次给出了延迟反馈下的强自适应保证，并自然推广到带时变记忆的在线凸优化，得到优于已知最好结果的界。属于在线学习理论研究，适合关注在线优化与自适应遗憾理论的工作者。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线凸优化理论研究，与 LLM 各关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Agentic Hazard Mapper: Emulating Expert Map-Making with AI Agents for Risk Communication
arxiv.abstract: Hazard maps are essential tools for public risk communication, preparedness, and evacuation planning, yet effective cartographic design is not always ensured due to limited access to cartographic expertise across local governments and communities. We present Agentic Hazard Mapper, a multi-agent system that automates hazard-map production by emulating professional cartographic workflows and iterative design trade-offs while adapting design decisions to different data, locations, and hazard contexts. We conducted a formative study with map experts to inform the system design, followed by a user study and interviews with map experts and hazard practitioners. The generated maps improved participants' spatial understanding and evacuation-planning performance, reduced perceived workload and task completion time, and were generally preferred over corresponding municipal maps. We further discuss human oversight, adaptation across users and communication contexts, and opportunities to extend agentic support across broader stages of hazard-map production and risk communication.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic Hazard Mapper:用 AI 智能体模拟专家制图，服务风险沟通
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对地方政府与社区普遍缺乏制图专业能力、灾害地图设计质量参差不齐的问题，构建多智能体系统 Agentic Hazard Mapper，模拟专业制图工作流与迭代式设计权衡，并针对不同数据、地点与灾害情境自适应调整设计决策。系统设计前先与地图专家开展形成性研究，随后通过用户研究与访谈进行评估。生成的地图提升了参与者的空间理解与疏散规划表现，降低了主观工作量与任务完成时间，且总体优于对应的市政地图。工作还讨论了人类监督与跨用户、跨沟通情境的适配，为把智能体支持扩展到灾害地图生产与风险沟通的更广环节提供参考。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体用于灾害制图垂直应用，仅擦边 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Internal Discrepancy for Contrastive Learning: Generalization Bounds and Downstream Behaviors
arxiv.abstract: Contrastive learning has emerged as a popular paradigm for training representation models. While prior studies pursue more practical and less restrictive assumptions to enhance theoretical understanding of contrastive learning, they essentially describe the interconnections among representations within the data or induced by the function class. To encapsulate these assumptions, we propose the measure of internal discrepancy that quantifies the difference between the mean representation of positive samples and latent cluster centers. We then prove an internal discrepancy-aware generalization bound for downstream supervised tasks following contrastive learning, without requiring additional assumptions. This generalization bound not only serves as a unifying framework connecting various assumptions but also motivates us to further reduce the internal discrepancy, thereby introducing the relaxed k-means loss as an approximation. Moreover, we investigate the downstream behaviors of contrastive learning from the perspective of contrastive learning-incurred supervised losses. In the presence of class imbalance, we shed light on why contrastive learning can facilitate imbalanced learning. Finally, we investigate the optimality of these incurred supervised losses, proving several intriguing properties.
arxiv.titleZh: 对比学习的内部差异:泛化界与下游行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对对比学习理论分析依赖各类数据或函数类假设的问题，提出「内部差异」度量，刻画正样本平均表示与潜在簇中心之间的差距，并在不附加额外假设的前提下，证明对比学习后下游监督任务的内部差异感知泛化界;该界可统一已有多种假设，并据此引入松弛 k-means 损失以降低内部差异。进一步从对比学习诱导的监督损失视角分析下游行为，解释类别不平衡时对比学习为何有益，并证明这些损失的多项最优性性质。
arxiv.reason: 对比学习泛化理论，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: PlayerEmbed: Learning Behavioral Fingerprint Representations from Raw Input Sequences
arxiv.abstract: Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we introduce PlayerEmbed, a framework that learns compact and discriminative player embeddings using deep metric learning. Our approach uses a hybrid CNN-LSTM encoder trained on raw input sequences from 1,000 players. We evaluate the model on held-out sequences from these players and on sequences from 1,000 players entirely unseen during training to assess generalization to unseen identities. For player identification, a nearest-centroid classifier built from reference embeddings achieves strong performance, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.950 for players seen during training and 0.879 for players unseen during training. Systematically increasing the number of training players substantially improves generalization to unseen players, indicating a transition from simple fingerprinting to learning transferable behavioral patterns.
arxiv.titleZh: PlayerEmbed：从原始输入序列学习行为指纹表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对游戏原始玩家输入序列维度高、噪声大、难以支撑大规模分析的问题，用深度度量学习学出紧凑且具判别力的玩家嵌入；编码器为 CNN-LSTM 混合结构，在 1000 名玩家的原始输入序列上训练，并以参考嵌入构建最近质心分类器完成玩家识别。训练集内玩家平衡准确率达 0.950，训练中完全未见的玩家达 0.879；系统增加训练玩家数量可显著提升对未见玩家的泛化，说明模型从简单的指纹匹配转向学习可迁移的行为模式。该表示为玩家行为分析、异常检测与个性化建模提供了可扩展的嵌入接口。
arxiv.reason: 游戏玩家行为指纹建模，与 LLM/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
arxiv.abstract: The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts. To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction. Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking. First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers. Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology. By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable. In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen's $κ$ scores of 0.640--0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human--human agreement range of 0.616--0.689. We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96\% are judged correct. The pipeline code and KG is publicly available https://github.com/aayushacharya/climatekg.
arxiv.titleZh: 本体引导的知识图谱构建：从结构化元数据与气候科学出版物出发
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对科学文献增长远超人工整理速度、结构化知识抽取受阻的问题，提出本体引导的智能体框架：由专职 agent 分工完成文档理解、信息抽取、本体一致性与实体链接，LLM 先抽取带文本证据的三元组，再经多阶段校验对齐本体，靠 schema 约束与原文片段保证语义一致与可溯源。在 1000 条三元组上与三位标注者的一致性达 Cohen's κ 0.640–0.700，与人类间 0.616–0.689 相当。用于 2000 篇气候科学论文，构建出 133,990 节点、755,308 条关系的知识图谱，验证后纳入的 23,327 条三元组中 98.96% 判为正确，代码与图谱已开源。
arxiv.reason: 科研文献理解的 agent 抽取流水线，属 AI for Research 但偏垂直领域

arxiv.title: CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model
arxiv.abstract: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker's underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness. We propose CounselPlex, a stressor-aware full-duplex framework that uses two operations. CounselPlex updates a short stressor state during seeker silence and injects this state into <PAD> positions while listening. We also introduce RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA), which broadens positional coverage during training and improves performance at longer turn depths in our evaluation. LLM-judge evaluations show improved counseling quality and stressor grounding over strong baselines.

arxiv.summaryZh: 全双工语音模型可边听边说，但在心理咨询场景中往往只盯住最新一句话，丢失来访者真正的困扰，该问题被定义为「压力源盲视」。CounselPlex 在来访者沉默期间增量更新一个简短的「压力源状态」，并在聆听时把该状态注入<PAD>位置，使模型持续携带问题线索；同时提出 RoPE 位置偏移增强（RPSA），扩大训练时的位置覆盖范围，在更长的对话轮次深度上提升表现。LLM-as-judge 评测显示其咨询质量与压力源落地程度优于强基线。工作面向低延迟语音心理咨询交互，方法上对全双工语音 LLM 的状态注入与位置编码训练有一定参考价值。

arxiv.title: Natural Language Autoencoders Identify Without Explaining
arxiv.abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) express a model's internal activations in the form of readable text. The verbalizer turns an activation into an English explanation; the reconstructor then converts that explanation back into an activation, and the explanation is considered successful if the round trip brings back the original activation. We claim that this criterion evaluates whether the information is sufficient and does not address descriptive faithfulness. A sentence can contain sufficient information to make it possible to identify an activation even if it wrongly explains what the activation does: in the case of reconstruction, the primary aim is to accurately identify the activations and not to describe them. This issue has the same structure as the chain-of-thought faithfulness problem, in which verbal output that has been trained to go with a process is taken as a report on that process, and it parallels the dissociation between an individual's introspective report and the actual governing process as documented in human psychology. Although proposed as interpretability tools for the purpose of alignment, NLAs reintroduce, through unverified explanations, the epistemic problem that they were intended to resolve.
arxiv.titleZh: 自然语言自编码器能识别，却无法解释
arxiv.summaryZh: 自然语言自编码器（NLA）先把模型内部激活转写成可读的英文解释，再由该解释重建原始激活，并以重建误差的大小作为判断解释是否成功的依据；该工作指出，这个判据只检验信息是否充分，并不检验描述是否忠实，因为一条错误解释只要足以唯一指认某个激活，就能通过重建测试。作者把这一问题与思维链忠实性问题视为结构相同，并类比人类心理学中内省报告与实际认知过程的分离，说明本为对齐而设计的可解释性工具，反而通过未经检验的解释重新引入了它试图解决的认知论难题。
arxiv.reason: 讨论可解释性工具的忠实性判据，与 CoT 忠实性同构，但属纯概念论证
